# Black Bag Security

Site: https://www.blackbagsecurity.com
Canonical domain: https://www.blackbagsecurity.com

Black Bag Security provides security testing and engineering for high-consequence systems. The practice combines senior-led penetration testing, red teaming, secure code review, reverse engineering, AI security, secure systems engineering, defensible evidence, protected client context, and verified closure.

## Primary buyer pages
- https://www.blackbagsecurity.com/
- https://www.blackbagsecurity.com/services/
- https://www.blackbagsecurity.com/capability/
- https://www.blackbagsecurity.com/about/

## Core services
- Penetration Testing
- Red Teaming
- Secure Code Review
- Reverse Engineering
- Secure Engineering

AI security is a cross-cutting specialization spanning models, agents, browsers, tools, identities, data boundaries, local/private execution, and human approval.

## Key capability and engineering systems
- Agentic Offensive Testing Platform (AOTP): local agentic offensive security, AI powered, human governed, private by design, evidence first.
- AI Browser Security Test Suite: repeatable security testing for browser-based AI systems and trust boundaries.
- Security Engagement Platform (SEP): evidence-led engagement control from scope and authority through verified closure.
- OSMAP + OpenBSD Mailstack: secure mail operations and hardened mail infrastructure for high-consequence systems.
- Custom Engineering: purpose-built security tooling, controls, automation, and infrastructure used when standard tooling is insufficient.

## Contact
- Engagement enquiries: hello@blackbagsecurity.com
- Security disclosure: security@blackbagsecurity.com
- Security policy: https://www.blackbagsecurity.com/.well-known/security.txt

## Operating principles
- Senior technical judgment stays close to the work.
- Evidence before assertion.
- Sensitive client context stays deliberately controlled.
- Testing and engineering reinforce each other.
- Remediation is followed through verified closure.
- No third-party tracking or analytics.
